svg.desc: Seven named display facets explain existing activation step 22 without adding milestones, a completion denominator or an effort percentage. PLAN, Permission + planning, is source-landed: permission d3f846916e121b18d57e9979c700aaa1000d4969, durable claim 4f9185c and private planning 4fc61c341420b96e785973f5c3cdd3c49748b97f. RECORDS, Durable stage records; IO, Guarded transports; and SQL, Grant / reserve / SQL, are source-landed in .183 commit 8f1b9a1c8b2cd6f31eac87ac169636ec3280b965. COMPLETE, Completion continuation, is source-landed in .184 commit 829064f27f82148de4bc41542631df0fa0aa6ff9: actual original-bound caller/server completion, durable raw4 retention and public signed-control admission, without public AES custody. RELEASE remains in progress and partial. Its five named connections are Prepare / export, source-landed in .185 commit fbdb6461454e4e3e47e064fe798497bf5de3d67a; Authorization, source-landed in .186 commit 93e0142f3b440682305a9d2bd937a441b3050423; Grant / reserve / SQL, source-landed in .187 commit f3b7781e2c5a83333ecf4b105fca37115cea09ce; Completion, source-landed in .188 commit ac569c81162fdd308ce93d7dd79402526768255b; and Protected handoff, still partial. Intent landed in .189 commit 30009db5d9ad08705545f7c89d49778c31938e1d; proof landed in .190 commit c4270fdb2c0b90f236da5ced7a4f4647bc3c9eac; exact fresh grants and same-permission socket landed in .191 commit 68d423531d295992edb369f07f988f3a405f606a; issuer policy, genuine grant issuance and wire foundations landed in .192 commit 18cf710e86597ade6ef5f1d803eb30a594b81bed. Current .193 issuer cold delivery, one-shot service and public-only parent v12 same-permission acquisition are source-landed in 0a46302ceabd62416e120f0c025e472dc6cac276. Actual resource observation/provisioning and delivery of the exact signed server bootstrap to the release worker remain open, as do consume-input acquisition and per-request proof provisioning. HTTP/cookie, separately authorized recovery and portal remain open. These are connections inside RELEASE, not additional milestones; the source HTTP data contract does not register a route or issue a cookie. Criteria are in the activation-dispatch-detail ledger. Activation remains 21/26 source-landed, 1 active and 4 other open; project 34/46 and production 0/6 are unchanged. Source is unbuilt and unexecuted; no service runtime, observed delivery or current-session claim follows.
